messages:
Maya: Thanks for staying on after the all-hands — quick follow-up on headcount and the org changes we outlined. I'll post the high-level plan and take questions here.
Derek: Appreciate this, Maya. Can you confirm which teams are getting the bulk of the FY28 hiring?
Maya: Primary hiring focus is Product (+40% of new reqs), Serving/Runtime (+30%), and Observability/Platform (+20%). Small amounts for Security and GTM motions. Numbers are provisional pending approvals.
Harper: Is this a net increase in headcount or redeploying existing roles?
Maya: Net increase. We have a headcount plan target for FY28 that assumes ~35 new hires across engineering + product, plus role-level backfills. We'll prioritize roles that unlock revenue or latency/cost wins.
Olivia: Any teams being merged or sunset? I heard a rumor about the 'batch-cache' project being folded into runtime — true?
Derek: Confirming — batch-cache as a discrete team will be integrated into eng-runtime and eng-platform. The work continues, but reporting lines will shift; no layoffs for that move.
Ravi: Timeline for manager-level moves? I have a direct who's wondering if they'll report to the new runtime lead.
Maya: Manager reassignments will happen over the next 3 weeks with individual outreach. If you haven't heard by EOW+3w, ping people-ops. We'll give at least 2 weeks notice before any changes take effect.
Sam: To add — transfers are voluntary by default when possible. We'll work with managers to minimize disruption and keep project continuity.
Annie: What's the process for applying internally to the new roles? Will there be an internal window?
Maya: Yes — there will be a 7-day internal applicant window for most posted roles before we open externally. Internal applicants get prioritized interviews and matched comp bands.
Harper: Speaking of comp bands, any changes to leveling or compensation because of the reorg?
Maya: No band changes tied to the reorg itself. We will publish updated role descriptions and expected level mapping. Compensation policy remains the same; exceptions handled case-by-case by People Ops.
Derek: For managers — please prepare 1:1 outreach scripts. People Ops will share a template to make conversations consistent and clear.
Ravi: Will hiring for Dedicated infra continue internationally or mostly US/EU?
Maya: Hiring footprint remains US + EU primary. We will selectively open roles in APAC for customer-facing and infra-critical positions where region matters.
Olivia: How will this affect our roadmap delivery for Redwood Optimize features?
Derek: We are keeping a small splinter of RD-Optimize in product to maintain momentum; some backend tasks move to eng-platform. Minimal impact expected on roadmap dates.
Annie: What's the fallback if approvals don't come through — is there a hiring freeze plan?
Sam: If we need to pause new reqs, we'll freeze external hiring but try to keep internal mobility open. We'll communicate any pause ASAP and provide managers with prioritization guidance.
Harper: For managers doing interviews — will there be updated scorecards reflecting new role scope?
Maya: Yes, updated scorecards and rubrics will be on the hiring wiki by Monday. We'll host a 30-min Q&A session for hiring managers on Tuesday.
Ravi: Any change to ramp expectations for new hires in Dedicated vs Hosted teams?
Derek: Slightly longer ramp for Dedicated because of infra onboarding and compliance checks (~2 extra weeks). We'll update new hire checklists.
Annie: Can People Ops share the org chart version that shows the team merges?
Maya: We'll post an updated org chart (v1) in the all-hands channel and the people wiki within 24 hours. It's a working doc and will change as we finalize owners.
Harper: Thanks — makes it clearer. One last thing: will reorged teams keep their existing OKRs or move to new ones immediately?
Derek: Transition quarter: existing OKRs stay for 6 weeks to avoid churn. After that teams will adopt refreshed OKRs aligned to the new structure.
allhands-bot: :calendar: Reminder: Manager Q&A on hiring playbook — Tue 10:00am PT. Link in #all-hands.
Maya: Thanks all — keep questions here and I'll answer as they come. If you need confidentiality, DM People Ops or me.
Olivia: Appreciate the clarity, Maya.
Ravi: Thanks — will share with my team.
Derek: I'll coordinate the outreach for runtime folks this afternoon.
Maya: Quick note — any proposed role that changes level by more than one band will be escalated for calibration.
Annie: Noted. Thanks everyone.
